summary: An animated narrative about Mira, a homemaker who feels embarrassed at her husband's office party because she cannot speak English. She downloads the English Seekho app, practices secretly at night using its AI coach, and confidently converses at the next party, making her husband proud. The ad promotes a 1-rupee trial and urges users to install the app.
